title: Why Your Bathroom Tiles Auto-Tune Your Voice
caption:
Your shower voice is fake - and your tiles are to blame
A guy belts 'La la la!' into a showerhead like a legend, then learns the truth and sulks inside a cardboard box.
Hard, smooth tiles reflect your sound waves back almost instantly, adding reverb that smooths and thickens your voice like a built-in auto-tune.
Be honest - do you sound like a popstar in there too?
Save this for your next shower concert and follow for more everyday science.
